meaning:
προσ-ανα-τίθημι
to lay on or offer besides; mid.,
(a) to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides;
(b) with genitive of person(s), of giving or obtaining information, to consult, communicate: Gal.1:16 2:6 (Lft., in l; cf. ἀνα-τίθημι)
(AS)

renderings.bsb: I did not rush to consult

renderings.kjv: to be somewhat in conference added

elsewhere.note: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
